ms.label: 7(a)
ms.text:
1 mark each for any 3 of:

lustrous / shiny

malleable

ductile

sonorous

conducts electricity / conducts heat

ms.label: 7(b)(ii)
ms.text:
basic oxide
AND
iron is a metal / it is a metal oxide

ms.label: 7(b)(iii)
ms.text:
suitable ending of sentence involving barrier method / galvanising or sacrificial protection e.g.
covering with plastic OR greasing OR galvanising
